title: Round spec
description: One unit of delegated work, written before an office starts and frozen when it starts.

id.description: Round id, also the file name.

inputs.description: One entry per repository the round reads; the exact commit the office starts from.

path.description: Repository or worktree folder, relative to the parent folder of the course repository, or a placeholder.

commit.description: Full commit id the branch is cut from.

modules_regex.description: The regex the gate passes to the tools, for example ^(4[1-5])-.

items.description: A gate command, run from the worktree root.

acceptance.description: Numbers the hand-back must meet, for example modules, practices_per_language, plants_per_practice_min, quizzes.

frozen_at.description: UTC time the office started; inputs and scope change only by a new round.
